en.summary: Cloudflare tools, credentials and static publication
details: swban deploy/cloudflare/auth/setup        #Set up authorization in a local page
swban deploy/cloudflare/wrangler pages deploy <build-path> --project-name <name> --branch preview  #Publish a preview; use an absolute build path

zh.summary: Cloudflare 工具、凭据与静态站发布
details: swban deploy/cloudflare/cli --help         #查看 cf 命令
swban deploy/cloudflare/wrangler --help    #查看 Wrangler 命令
swban deploy/cloudflare/auth/setup        #打开本机授权设置页
swban deploy/cloudflare/auth/token/check  #检查已保存的 Token
swban deploy/cloudflare/wrangler pages deploy <build-path> --project-name <name> --branch preview  #发布预览；构建路径用绝对路径
